entities.summary: Herintsalama Andriamiasy Rajaonarivelo is a Malagasy politician, businessman, and economist who served as the Prime Minister of Madagascar from October 2025 until March 2026. Prior to his appointment as prime minister, Rajaonarivelo served as Chairman of the Board of Directors of BNI Madagascar and was thus a prominent figure in the Malagasy economic and banking sector.
